name: Fehu
interpretation: Fehu represents wealth, abundance and material gain. It can indicate new financial opportunities or the need to tend to what you already have.

name: Uruz
interpretation: Uruz symbolizes physical strength, willpower and endurance. It suggests you have the strength to overcome challenges.

name: Thurisaz
interpretation: Thurisaz represents a catalyst for change, often through conflict. It can indicate protection or a need to defend yourself.

name: Ansuz
interpretation: Ansuz represents communication, wisdom and divine inspiration. Pay attention to signs and messages from the universe.

name: Raidho
interpretation: Raidho indicates a journey, whether physical or spiritual. It suggests progress and moving forward on your path.

name: Kenaz
interpretation: Kenaz represents the light of knowledge and creativity. Illumination is coming, revealing what was hidden.

name: Gebo
interpretation: Gebo represents gifts, partnerships and exchanges. It emphasizes balance in giving and receiving.

name: Wunjo
interpretation: Wunjo is a rune of joy, comfort and harmony. Good times are ahead, enjoy the moment.

name: Hagalaz
interpretation: Hagalaz represents sudden disruption or natural forces beyond your control. Difficult but transformative.

name: Nauthiz
interpretation: Nauthiz represents necessity and constraint. Through limitations comes innovation and strength.

name: Isa
interpretation: Isa suggests a time of standstill. Be patient, this frozen period will pass.

name: Jera
interpretation: Jera represents the harvest and natural cycles. Your efforts will bear fruit in due time.

name: Eihwaz
interpretation: Eihwaz symbolizes endurance and transformation through challenge. Like the yew, you will survive.

name: Perthro
interpretation: Perthro represents hidden knowledge and fate. Trust the mysteries that are being revealed.

name: Algiz
keywords: protection, defense, sanctuary, connection to the divine
interpretation: Algiz is a powerful protective rune. You are divinely protected and guided.

name: Sowilo
interpretation: Sowilo represents success, vitality and life force. Victory and wholeness are yours.

name: Tiwaz
interpretation: Tiwaz represents justice, honor and leadership. Stand up for what is right.

name: Berkano
interpretation: Berkano symbolizes new growth and fresh starts. Like spring, new life is emerging.

name: Ehwaz
interpretation: Ehwaz represents progress and partnership. Work together to move forward.

name: Mannaz
interpretation: Mannaz represents the self and humanity. Know thyself and work with others.

name: Laguz
interpretation: Laguz represents intuition and flow. Trust your inner knowing and go with the flow.

name: Ingwaz
interpretation: Ingwaz represents potential and gestation. Something is growing within, be patient.

name: Dagaz
interpretation: Dagaz represents breakthrough and awakening. The dawn is breaking, clarity is here.

name: Othala
interpretation: Othala represents inheritance and ancestral wisdom. Honor your roots and legacy.
